title: Lipid Biomarker Extraction
author: Lucia Leierer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yg2ftye
materials: Elude other compounds with 2 DV of Methanol
Neutralize with saturated sodium bicarbonate solution

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sediment samples for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Oven dry sediment samples at 60 °C for 48:00:00.
Subsample 5 g of homogenized sediment.

steps.title: Lipid Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract lipids from the sediment using a solvent mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 mL dichloromethane/methanol (DCM/MeOH) 9:1 v/v to the sediment.
Mix for 00:30:00 in a sonicator (keep temperature below 30 °C).
Transfer the solvent into a centrifuge tube and centrifuge for 00:10:00 at 4700 rpm.
Filter the centrifuged solvent through annealed glass wool and evaporate with N2.

steps.title: Repeat Extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction process to ensure maximum recovery.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the addition of solvent, sonication, centrifugation, and evaporation steps two more times.

steps.title: Column Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the chromatography column with packing materials.

substeps.instruction: Add a small ball of annealed glass wool to the column.
Add 0.1 g of sand (50-70 mesh, previously fired at 450 °C for 10:00:00) to the column.
Add 1 g of silica (70-230 mesh, previously fired at 450 °C for 10:00:00) to the column.

steps.title: Sample Loading
steps.instruction: Load the extracted lipids onto the column.

substeps.instruction: Add lipids reconstituted in DCM to the column, adding about 9 drops every 10 minutes.
Cover the column in aluminium foil and leave for at least 12 hours.

steps.title: Fractionation
steps.instruction: Separate the lipid biomarkers into fractions using specific solvents.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the dead volume (DV) using n-hexane.
Elute n-alkanes with 3/8 DV using n-hexane.
Elute aromatics with 2 DV of 8/2 v:v n-hexane/DCM.
Elute ketones with 2 DV of DCM.
Elute alcohols with 2 DV of 1/1 v:v DCM/Ethyl acetate.
Elute acids and diols with 2 DV of Ethyl acetate.

steps.title: Fraction Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Evaporate and store the collected fractions.

substeps.instruction: Evaporate all fractions using N2 at 30 °C.
Store fractions at -20 °C until measurement.

steps.title: Reconstitution of Fractions
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the dried fractions with internal standards and solvents.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute n-alkanes with 5α-androstane (8mg/L) and 150 µL of DCM.
Reconstitute aromatics with 5α-androstane (8mg/L) and 50 µL of DCM.
Reconstitute ketones with 5α-androstan-3-ol (8mg/L) and 50 µL of DCM.
Reconstitute acids and diols with Methyl C19:0 (8mg/L), 40 µL of DCM, and 10 µL of Ethyl acetate.
Reconstitute alcohols with 5α-androstan-3-ol (8mg/L), 40 µL of DCM, and 10 µL of Ethyl acetate.
Reconstitute other compounds with Methyl C19:0 (8mg/L), 40 µL of DCM, and 10 µL of Ethyl acetate.
Add 100 µL of N,O-Bis(trimethylsilyl)trifluoroacetamide (BSTFA) + trimethylchlorosilane (TCMS) 99:1 v/v and 100 µL of pyridine to the extract.
Dry the sample under N2.

steps.title: Fatty Acid Derivatization
steps.instruction: Derivatize fatty acids via acid-catalyzed transesterification.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL of MeOH and 400 µL of H2SO4 to the extract.
Heat at 70 °C for 04:00:00.
Extract three times with 3 mL n-hexane and dry under nitrogen.
